generatedBy: map-lab measure, map-lab-core 0.1.0: each recipe built once per seed, the recipe's own seed replaced

columns.floor_share: Walkable tiles over all tiles. Walkable: floor, grass, treasure and traps; not wall, water or mountain.
columns.regions: Groups of walkable tiles joined in four directions.
columns.dead_ends: Walkable tiles with exactly one walkable neighbour of four.
columns.corridor_ratio: The share of walkable tiles in no 2 x 2 block of walkable tiles: passages one tile wide.
columns.path: Steps on the shortest four-way walk from start to exit; null when there is none.
columns.probed: 1 when path used the standard probe (the open tile nearest the middle of the left edge to the one nearest the middle of the right) because the map has no start and exit of its own; 0 otherwise.
columns.field_mean: The noise field's mean, for maps that have one; null otherwise.
columns.field_sd: The noise field's standard deviation, for maps that have one; null otherwise.
columns.rooms: Rooms placed, for maps built from rooms; null otherwise.

rowLayout: each row: [seed, then the columns in order, then the seed's failures]

failures.prefab-no-place: a prefab stage found no place for its prefab (the talk's loop would run forever)
failures.exit-unreachable: the exit stage's exit can't be walked to from the start
failures.no-floor: a stage needed a walkable tile and the map had none
failures.guard-hit: a loop the talk leaves uncapped hit our cap: a particle that never lands, a prefab that never fits
failures.disconnected: the walkable tiles form more than one region
failures.no-path: no walk from start to exit (the map's own, or the standard probe's)
failures.short-path: start and exit fewer than a quarter of the map's width apart, in steps
failures.few-rooms: a room generator placed fewer than four rooms
